hook.text: Yahoo revealed that all three billion of its user accounts had been compromised. Every single one.

buildup.text: The breach happened in 2013 but wasn't disclosed until 2016 — three years of silence.

discovery.text: Hackers stole names, emails, phone numbers, birth dates, and security questions.

twist.text: The breach was revealed during Verizon's acquisition of Yahoo, reducing the sale price by $350 million.

climax.text: Yahoo proved that companies can hide breaches for years while millions remain exposed.

punchline.text: Three billion accounts. Three years of silence.

quiz.question: How many Yahoo accounts were compromised in the mega-breach?
